messages:
Anya D.: pushed a small comp for the version history — trying a compact timeline with an inline diff peek on hover. thoughts?
Marco P.: love the idea of diff peek. question: does hover remove keyboard discoverability?
Anya D.: good call — plan is hover for pointer users + a keyboard action (Enter on focused item) to open the same diff pane. also adding a small "preview" affordance (.icon-eye) so it looks clickable.
Ravi K.: from runtime side we can provide a lightweight diff payload for the last 5 commits — should be under 10kb. need to confirm cache key so we don't spam the api.
Olivia A.: accessibility nits: ensure the preview pane is reachable via keyboard, and use role="dialog" with aria-modal="false" (it's a lightweight peek). Also add aria-live="polite" for status updates when canary allocation changes.
Eva M.: copy question: currently CTA says "Rollback". product prefers "Revert to version X" for clarity. any objections?
Marco P.: prefer "Revert to version X". "Rollback" sounds a bit harsh and users sometimes misinterpret it as a full purge.
Anya D.: updated comps with "Revert to version X". Also added an inline confirmation microcopy: "This will route new traffic to version X; existing in-flight requests may complete on previous version." short and testable.
Ravi K.: engineer nit: if we do a one-click revert we need an undo window or a quick rollback path. suggest we show a toast with "Undo (30s)" that triggers the API to restore previous allocation.
Olivia A.: for screen readers, announce: "Reversion initiated. You can undo within 30 seconds." and set focus to the toast's Undo button when it appears.
Anya D.: design decision: show keyboard scrubber on timeline — arrows to step through versions, space/enter to preview diff, press R to revert (with modal). does that feel intuitive?
Marco P.: maybe R is too discoverable; would prefer a visible keyboard hint in help overlay rather than a global single-key shortcut.
Ravi K.: agree. single-key shortcuts cause conflicts. help overlay hint + explicit focusable controls. implementation ok on our side.
deploy-bot: snapshot created for deploy-2026-03-02-1765432100
Eva M.: accessibility contrast: allocation bars currently use pastel greens that fail AA at small widths. can we bump contrast or add pattern fill?
Anya D.: switching to a higher-sat green and adding a diagonal hatch for small bars. will prototype both.
Olivia A.: diagonal hatch is great as a non-color indicator. also add an off-screen label: "Canary: 5%" that reads when focus enters the bar.
Marco P.: final checklist before we sign off on this iteration: 1) diff peek keyboard modal + aria roles, 2) "Revert to version X" copy + toast undo, 3) canary presets (1/5/25) with stepper presets, 4) contrast/pattern for bars, 5) help overlay keyboard hints.
Anya D.: documenting on the ticket now and will upload updated figma. ACTION: Anya — update comps (due EOD). ACTION: Ravi — confirm API diff payload/cache (tomorrow). ACTION: Olivia — write SR text for screen readers (tomorrow).
Marco P.: thanks — sync tomorrow standup if needed. :thumbsup:
